instruction: I think if we start with easy sets on my weak areas and work up to hard sets we can find the pattern pick a historic figure to name the experiment.  after find the general rules and rules compressions patch and fix as we go  look at all tests ran all patterns we have found name the test Pole and make pole able to generate new cases and pin old ones as it tests so we can seed generate many tests like my dice bag in b tests https://github.com/mitchell-d00/B-Tests use any of my past work to devise Pole
scope: Add Pole, the Frederick Douglass experiment, with seeded difficulty levels, 75 inherited weakness classes, selected-case pinning, separate key custody and before/after diagnostics.
Normalize two equivalent recorded-value field requests through one shared whole-question rule and retain strict verification.
Publish frozen local research packets, development keys, baseline failures and exact replay receipts in the Pole evidence directory.
validation: The 48-case focus replay improved from 5 to 16 complete answers out of 28, preserved all 20 expected withholds and recovered two cited conflicts.
The 120-case inherited catalog replay kept all scores and graph obligations, including 79 expected withholds.
The 25-case transfer draw verified five new target answers and replayed a pinned conflict with both cited values.
The independently worded regression failed on the baseline and passed after the rule repair.

The committed source archive passed 66 focused Python tests, 52 public evidence controls, actual Pyodide, and local Chromium. The historical replay matched all 22 strict rows and all 48 Scout graph passes.

The restricted 1,701-test archive run recorded 11 socket errors, three dependent journey failures and two skips. The 94 tests in the affected modules all passed from the same archive with loopback access.
limitations: The local Pole worker receives no scoring key and runs without OS isolation. The frozen Pole cases are synthetic development evidence.
The transfer draw reached the sorter repeated-phrase grouping budget on one explicit-chain case. Independent historical accuracy remains unmeasured.
The documented hosted release and deployment gates are separate from the local experiment.
next_steps: Pin the phrase-budget case and compare matched request, dispatch and receipt records across evidence complexity.
Build targeted ladders for attribution, dates, partial corrections and wording changes before promoting further rules.
